answer: Willow Lottery is a precomputation-resistant Sybil defense using verifiable randomness from blockchain entropy. Each user may claim ONE random number at dawn from a commitment generated by the terrace protocol, which hashes together block headers from 100 prior blocks to create unpredictable output. To register an identity, a claim must match a preselected target range verified by on-chain proof; the user pays a fixed fee in native tokens to initiate the draw, which is slashed if the commitment is proven manipulable.
